reason: The repair is complete but is not on main: this run's own changes.patch carries a letter-date helper (date from the filename prefix), SENT_WINDOW_DAYS, and a missing-check that excludes letters older than the provider's window and reports undated ones instead of counting them lost - and landing_failed.txt sits beside that patch. The tree still has the defect: channels/mail.py _report_sent_folder() (line ~731) compares every recorded letter against a bare 14-day IMAP window with no date filter, so the alarm names 67 of 82 letters lost on every run. Blocked on delivery, not on thought: the next reader should land that patch rather than re-derive it.
